frases: That rock from the river can blow up in your fire pit!
Hit like and follow. Flo says I'm making it up!
Rocks don't explode! They're rocks! That's a myth!
River rocks sat in water for years. Some of it is still trapped inside.
Light a fire, and that water turns to steam.
The steam has nowhere to go, so the rock cracks. Sometimes, it pops!
Okay, but mine are totally dry. I picked them up last summer.
Dry on the outside. And every rain soaks them up again.
So what am I supposed to use? Nothing?
Fire brick inside the ring. Or dense stone made for fire pits.
Keep river rock out of the flames, and away from the ring.
Fine. But I'm keeping the cute ones for the garden.
River rocks in a fire pit. Myth, or real danger? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
